sources.title: Microsoft Agent 365 Connected platforms
sources.note: Lists Bedrock and Claude Managed Agents. OpenAI is absent. Bedrock permissions include invocation and DeleteAgent.

sources.title: AWS CloudFormation AWS::Bedrock::Agent reference
sources.note: Verifies agent properties, automatic preparation, tags, safe deletion checks, and AgentId outputs.

sources.title: Create a service role for Amazon Bedrock Agents
sources.note: Verifies Bedrock service trust, source account/ARN conditions, InvokeModel, and omission of unused permissions.

sources.title: Supported Regions for Amazon Bedrock Agents
sources.note: Requires customer verification of regional availability. Warns Agents Classic is unavailable to new customers.

sources.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic maintenance mode
sources.note: Agents Classic closed to new customers on July 30, 2026. AgentCore is a separate migration path.

sources.title: AWS CLI create-change-set
sources.note: Verifies CREATE/UPDATE change sets, local template input, parameters, tags, and CAPABILITY_IAM.

sources.title: AWS CloudFormation DescribeChangeSet
sources.note: Verifies Status, StatusReason, ExecutionStatus, stack identity, and tags. Response does not expose ChangeSetType.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents quickstart
sources.note: Verifies agent, environment, session, and event sequence, API origin, version header, and beta header.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents overview and beta access
sources.note: Managed Agents is stateful. It is not currently eligible for Zero Data Retention or HIPAA BAA coverage.

sources.title: Claude API Create Agent
sources.note: Verifies POST /v1/agents, model/system/tools fields, metadata, agent IDs, version, and workspace header.

sources.title: Claude API Create Environment
sources.note: Verifies cloud environments with limited networking, empty allowed_hosts, and disabled MCP/package-manager exceptions.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents Start a session
sources.note: Verifies pinned agent version request, environment_id, idle creation, and explicit user events to start work.

sources.title: Claude API Get Session
sources.note: Verifies GET /v1/sessions/{session_id} and the resolved agent snapshot used before sending synthetic work.

sources.title: Claude API Send Events
sources.note: Verifies POST events array, user.message text blocks, and data array containing accepted event IDs.

sources.title: Claude API List Events
sources.note: Verifies GET events, order/limit/page pagination, next_page, session errors, and idle stop_reason objects.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents Session budgets
sources.note: Budget amount uses whole US cents as strings. In-flight requests can exceed the configured list-cost budget.

sources.title: Claude API Delete Session
sources.note: Documents permanent DELETE /v1/sessions/{session_id} and session_deleted confirmation.

sources.title: Claude API Delete Environment
sources.note: Documents DELETE /v1/environments/{environment_id} and environment_deleted confirmation.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents Define your agent
sources.note: Agent archive is irreversible and preserves existing sessions. It is not permanent deletion.

sources.title: Claude API Archive Agent
sources.note: Verifies POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/archive and archived_at confirmation. No agent DELETE route was verified.

sources.title: Claude API Get Workspace
sources.note: Verifies wrkspc_ ID examples. This demo does not call organization administration APIs.

sources.title: Claude API Get Environment
sources.note: Verifies GET /v1/environments/{environment_id}, cloud networking policy, package lists, archival state, and metadata checked before session creation.
